response.overview: 'The Witchy Girls' is a supernatural drag-comedy that reimagines 90s teen-witch stories through a chaotic and incredibly “internet” lens. What if the witches at the heart of your favourite supernatural teen show were not heroines but instead bad self involved people. Best friends Lazy Susan and Zelda Moon stumble through high-school armed with spells…and very big hair. It’s 'Sabrina the Teenage Witch' meets 'It’s Always Sunny'…but QUEER AS HELL! SCREAM
